title: Scrap Swing
hook: Each recovered piece widens a swinging magnetic load: fit it back through a wreck, bank it, or risk another pickup.
audience: Players who like tactile retrieval and short skill-based risk decisions.
core_loop: Swing, retrieve snapped cargo, return through the gap, bank or take another piece.
working_title_note: Working name; no name or trademark clearance established.
evidence_limits: Desk research only. No competitor hands-on session, own playable build, target-player interview, fun validation or purchase-intent measurement. Historical topic growth is distinct from a verified current trend phase.
commercial_hypothesis: Offline premium Windows microgame. USD 3.99–5.99 is a price hypothesis to test against the finished experience, not an agreed price or sales forecast. No sales volume estimated.

cash_assumptions.note: Planning inputs only, no spending authorized. Existing machine/tools assumed; subscription/compute costs not measured. Steam fee and any applicable store tax separate from optional assets.

calendar_note: Build estimates include the prototype, final-direction art/audio, finite content, save/settings, packaged Windows QA and draft store media. Steam onboarding/review/waiting and recruitment are separate; no launch date committed.
support_estimate: Reserve 1–2 owner hours around launch for triage/review, with agent implementation as needed; actual demand and defect burden unknown.

decision_history.reason: Not rejected as a game; outside the corrected trend-first discovery shortlist.

evidence.claim: Claw-driven play has a paid adjacent reference, but its combat and buildcraft are not the proposed salvage mechanic.
Small purposive review sampling in tactile-notes.md found complaints about shallow content; one crane interaction does not ensure a complete product.
A recent crane comparable has one Steam-purchase review in our consistent snapshot. That is limited visible response, not sales data.

risks: No rising search/activity signal established; developed during the initial store-first pass.
Cargo physics and replay/value remain untested.
next_test: Revisit only if an activity trend naturally suggests this interaction, or the owner chooses an evergreen arcade experiment. One-day test of fixed snapped cargo and clear gap clearance; no freeform chains.
decision_reason: Held from this shortlist because it was discovered from game comparisons and has no verified topic-growth connection. Preserve as an evergreen alternative.

production_envelope.scope: One pendulum body, six-piece cargo cap, three layouts, eight contracts. See tactile-notes.md.
